item.title: Xiaomi will now let you pre-order its first NAS — and at a surprisingly attractive price for customers everywhere
item.description: Xiaomi's first NAS starts at CNY 2,699 with drives included, uses the same chip as Synology's 2023 budget boxes, and isn't yet available outside China.

item.title: Robotics startup Generalist reaches $3B valuation, sources say
item.description: The $200 million extension comes just months after the physical AI startup reached a $2 billion valuation.

item.title: OpenAI loses a top data center exec, as stream of high-profile departures continues
item.description: Before Malone left, OpenAI had already reshuffled its infrastructure org, shifting his reporting line away from President Greg Brockman and putting Vice President Sachin Katti in charge of the group.
